<h1>Bottom row</h1>

The LC bottom row primarily controls **sequencer autodrops**. The full autodrop reference is [Autodrops](/documentation/MSEQ/autodrops). This page documents the non-autodrop functions that the same buttons expose when a modifier is held.

---

## Button layout

The LC bottom row has 7 sequencer buttons, one per column, matching the top mute row. They are labelled here as the **autodrop buttons** for sequencer 1–7 (U1/U3/U5 templates) or sequencer 9–15 (U2/U4/U6 templates). The eighth button in the row is not a sequencer: it is the `8B` modifier (see [LaunchControl modifier buttons](/documentation/MSEQ/lc-status)).

---

## Non-Autodrop Functions

When a modifier is held while pressing a bottom-row button, the autodrop action is replaced:

| LC modifier held | Bottom row action |
|-----------------|-------------------|
| *(none)* | Autodrop cue (see [Autodrops](/documentation/MSEQ/autodrops)) |
| **SHIFT** | **Decrement sequencer octave** for that column's seq (down to −4). Tap repeatedly to step down. |
| **MUTE** | **Decrement keyboard octave** for that column's seq (down to 0). |
| **REC ARM** | 16-bar autodrop cue (autodrop fires and lasts a full 16-bar cycle) |

These functions mirror the top-row modifier behaviour but in the downward direction: SHIFT/MUTE on top row increment, SHIFT/MUTE on bottom row decrement.

### Octave ranges

| Octave type | Range |
|-------------|-------|
| Sequencer octave | −4 to +4 |
| Keyboard (jam kbd) octave | 0 to +8 |

---

## LED colours

Bottom-row LED colours reflect the **sequencer autodrop state**, using the same colours as the top row:

| State | Bottom row LED |
|-------|---------------|
| No autodrop pending | Off |
| Cued to mute-drop | Flashing off/red |
| Mute-drop running | Red |
| Cued to CC drop | Flashing off/yellow |
| CC drop running | Yellow |
| Cued to note drop | Flashing off/orange |
| Note drop running | Orange |
| Cued to mute on the 16 | Flashing off/green |
| Cued to unmute on the 16 | Yellow |

---
